title: done names the host load when a check that bounds a test's wall time fails on a loaded host
goal: a done check that bounds wall time (a tests.py --durations run read against a seconds bound) is refused with the host's 5-minute load named when the load is over bl_selfcheck.SUITE_LOAD_PER_CORE per core, as a review's whole-suite run is, instead of failing as the work's own fault (SP-qlpfcgs2: BG-w6z2zc6r's 8 s bound failed at 8.10 s at a load near 7.8 on 14 cores while a sibling worker ran its suite, and passed on the retry)
notes: Evidence: backlog.py ops SP-qlpfcgs2, done.refused BG-w6z2zc6r reasons=check-failed at 2026-10-13T08:12:07Z; the first land pass had removed the worker's worktree (ST-q3k2zl6u).
